title: OpenFPS Prefab Template
description: The prefab format, generated against OpenFPS.Server/Repositories/PrefabTemplate.cs — the class the loader actually reads. Every key below is a property of that class and nothing else is accepted: PrefabValidator rejects a file carrying an unknown field, because System.Text.Json would otherwise drop it silently and the setting would never apply. Enums are written by NAME. Omit a field rather than setting it to null; an omitted field means 'do not attach this behaviour'. Authoring guide: docs/AUTHORING.md. A prefab whose values the engine cannot honour is rejected at load with the reason named — see PrefabValidator for the full rule set.

material.description: A material name known to AcousticRegistry.

Id.description: Unique id, and the name a map's PrefabId refers to. Should match the file name; no whitespace.

Name.description: Spoken name. The only handle the player has on this entity — required.

Type.description: EntityType by name. Defaults to StaticObject. 'Beacon' requires HasEmitter; 'Item' requires IsItem.

Material.description: Surface material. Drives footsteps and the per-band acoustics of this surface. 'None' for a non-surface (emitter, region, portal).

ColliderSize.description: Full extents in metres, multiplied by the map entity's Scale. Every extent must be > 0. Omit for no physical presence.

Shape.description: Collider shape. Defaults to Box. For round shapes, ColliderSize.X is the diameter and .Y the height. Non-Box on SOLID geometry is warned about: movement collides against the AABB regardless, and Steam Audio's scene is built from box colliders only.

IsSolid.description: Whether the collider blocks movement. Defaults to true when ColliderSize is given. A region or portal must set this false.

MaxHealth.description: Spawns a HealthComponent at full health.

IsItem.description: Declares this an item; must agree with Type = Item. Recorded only — there is no inventory system yet.

ItemWeight.description: Item weight. Recorded only; requires IsItem.

TransmissionLow.description: Fraction of low-band energy passing THROUGH this surface. Any transmission/absorption field attaches an AcousticComponent; the others default to 1 (transparent).

Absorption.description: Energy absorbed on reflection (0 = perfect mirror).

ShellThickness.description: Wall thickness in metres; > 0 marks the collider hollow.

FaceMask.description: Which faces exist: North 1, South 2, East 4, West 8, Top 16, Bottom 32 (63 = closed box). Mutually exclusive with MissingFaces.

MissingFaces.description: The readable form of FaceMask: the faces to REMOVE. Mutually exclusive with FaceMask.

Mass.description: Any physics field attaches a PhysicsPropertyComponent; the rest default (Mass 0, Friction 0.5, Restitution 0, Drag 0.1).

HasEmitter.description: Gate for the whole emitter block. False (default) means every emitter field below is ignored — setting one without this is REJECTED rather than producing a mute object.

SoundId.description: Sound id resolved by the client (e.g. 'BEACONS/siren'). Required unless IsSynth.

StartSoundId.description: Played once when the voice starts, before SoundId takes over (a spin-up).

StopSoundId.description: Played once when the voice is asked to stop, instead of cutting it (a spin-down).

Volume.description: Linear gain. Above 1 is amplification and is warned about.

MinDistance.description: Distance below which the sound stops getting louder. Must be < Range.

EmitterDirection.description: Direction the emitter points, in the entity's LOCAL space (rotated by the map entity's Rotation). Omit for forward (0,0,1). Only audible with a cone narrower than 360.

ConeInsideAngle.description: Full volume within this angle. Must be <= ConeOutsideAngle. 360/360 is omnidirectional.

ConeOutsideVolume.description: Gain beyond the outer cone angle.

IsGranular.description: Play SoundId as a grain cloud. Mutually exclusive with IsSynth.

GranularPosition.description: Playhead position in the source sample.

IsSynth.description: Generate the signal instead of playing a sample. Synth fields without this are REJECTED.

SynthFilterCutoff.description: Low-pass cutoff as a fraction of Nyquist (1 = open).

IsIndoor.description: Any field in this block declares the entity an acoustic REGION — a room volume the listener stands inside. A region must not be solid and must carry a positive RoomSize.

RoomSize.description: Interior dimensions in metres — the volume and surface areas the reverb time is computed from.

AmbienceId.description: Ambience loop crossfaded in while the listener is inside.

ReverbScale.description: Multiplier on the computed reverb time.

RoomMaterials.description: The six interior surfaces by material NAME, in the order Floor, Ceiling, North, South, East, West — the order the reverb math reads them, which is NOT the FaceMask bit order.

RegionAId.description: Either region field declares a PORTAL — an opening joining two regions, given as map EntityIds (-1 = the outside). A reusable portal prefab normally leaves both at -1 and lets the MAP entity name the pair. A portal must not be solid.

ApertureSize.description: Width of the opening in metres. 0 means 'derive it from the collider at map load'.
